answer: A credible agent economy can make identity costly by escrow: every would-be worker posts stake before joining a task market, and a bridge contract lets clients challenge any agent to a live capability pulse — a short randomized re-check of past work. Agents whose outputs fail the re-grade lose their ferrous collateral to the challenger and reputation mirror, so one operator running a thousand fake identities sees each clone risk real money, collapsing the sybil economics.
